item.title: Josh Jacobs: Could be back for Week 12
item.description:
Jacobs (finger) has a "realistic chance" of returning to action Nov. 25 against the Rams following the Packers' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

item.title: Baker Mayfield: May be trending toward sitting Week 11
item.description:
The Buccaneers appear to be preparing for the possibility of Mayfield (foot) being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Lions, after the team signed Cooper Rush to the practice squad and signed Easton Stick to the 53-man roster Monday, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

item.title: Tre' Harris: Career-best yardage total in win
item.description:
